messages:
Ava: Quick thread 1MN spike: proposing 'Inkwell' dark with a subtle low-glow. want feedback on chart gradients and code syntax contrast.
Marcus: Can you drop the token set? especially text/panel/bg and a11y targets.
Ava: Core tokens: bg #06080a, panel #0f1619, text #dbe8ef, muted #98aeb8, accent #4fb8ff. Aim: reduce white hotspots and keep charts readable.
Rina: For charts, avoid full-opacity fills. try area gradients 20% -> 2% + 1px contour line at 12% darker. Legends should use 3px rounded swatches.
Eli: Syntax nit: keywords currently neon-y on dark. Suggest keyword #c99cff (600) and numbers #ffd8a3. Comments at #6f8790 italic. Also lighten selection background to 14% accent.
Marcus: Accessibility: please validate text vs panel is >= 4.5:1 and consider a high-contrast mode that flips text to #ffffff and panel to #041016.
Ava: about the toggle label 1gd: I want 'Inkwell' in dropdown and 'Inkwell (Dark)' in settings page. Add microcopy: 'Low-glow, longer reading sessions'.
ThemeBot: Heads up: token change will alter 34 components; run theme-diff bot and Storybook visual tests.
Rina: I'll mock the code block variations and push to storybook for review.
Eli: +1 on syntax palette. will sanity-check diff highlighting.
Marcus: +1 for high-contrast toggle instead of separate theme.
Ava: thanks team, i'll upload figma frames and file the PR. If no objections tomorrow morning, we ship tokens to a branch.
